question: Shobhana Ranade's legacy as a Gandhian is most closely aligned with which contemporary governance initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shobhana Ranade was a dedicated Gandhian known for her commitment to social welfare and community development, resonating with the principles of cleanliness, sanitation, and grassroots empowerment.
 
• Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on October 2, 2014, emphasizes cleanliness and sanitation, aligning closely with Gandhian ideals of self-reliance and hygiene.
 
• The mission aims to eliminate open defecation and improve waste management in both rural and urban areas, addressing foundational societal issues that Gandhian philosophy advocates resolving.
 
• Shobhana Ranade’s legacy of community-driven initiatives mirrors the participatory approach of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, where citizens are actively engaged in improving their surroundings.
 
• The campaign is a tribute to Mahatma Gandhi's vision of a clean and self-sufficient India, making it highly relevant to Gandhian principles and Ranade's lifelong work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:**

 
 
• It is a nationwide cleanliness campaign initiated by the Government of India with the goal of achieving universal sanitation coverage.
 
• The mission has two sub-components: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) for rural areas and Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) for cities and towns.
 
• By 2019, India was declared open-defecation free (ODF), a milestone achieved under this campaign.
 
 
 
• **Gandhian Philosophy on Cleanliness:**
 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi often emphasized the importance of sanitation, stating, "Sanitation is more important than independence."
 
• He believed cleanliness was essential for individual dignity and societal progress.
 
• Gandhian principles advocate community participation and local solutions to improve hygiene and living standards.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:**
 
 
• Construction of household toilets with subsidies provided to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
 
• Promotion of awareness campaigns to encourage behavioral changes regarding hygiene practices.
 
• Improved waste management systems to ensure proper disposal and recycling.
 
 
 
• **Role of Civil Society:**
 
 
• Civil society organizations, like the ones Shobhana Ranade has been associated with, play a pivotal role in supporting Swachh Bharat initiatives.
 
• Community-led efforts ensure sustainable and effective implementation of cleanliness drives.
